booking.deposit_note: A 20% deposit is required to confirm a booking. The remaining balance is due 30 days before departure.
booking.minimum_advance_note: Bookings must be made at least 7 days before the departure date.
booking.group_note: Packages are available for 1–20 travellers. Groups larger than 20 require a custom quote.

cancellation.note: Cancellation must be submitted in writing via email. Refunds are processed within 10 business days.

payment.instalment_note: Instalment plans are available for packages over $800. Contact us to arrange.

changes.date_change_note: Date changes are permitted up to 14 days before departure for a $50 fee per person, subject to availability.
changes.destination_change_note: Destination changes are treated as a cancellation and re-booking.

never_included: Meals not specified in the package

age_policy.children_note: Children under 18 must travel with an adult. Children under 2 travel free (no seat). Ages 2–11 receive a 15% discount on the package price.
age_policy.senior_note: No age maximum. Travellers over 70 are advised to declare any pre-existing medical conditions at booking.

travel_insurance.note: Travel insurance is strongly recommended but not mandatory. Dreams Escapes can arrange comprehensive cover as an add-on at checkout.

complaints.note: All complaints are acknowledged within 48 hours and resolved within 14 business days.

loyalty.redemption_note: Earn 1 point per $1 spent. 500 points = $10 discount on your next booking.
